continuity_scope: ATLUS/SEGA English (US) official-site witness for the base Unicorn Overlord release on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The scope is the English 16-card character selector and base-game story/system copy. Physical/digital editions, the MONARCH Edition and pre-order bonus, demo, downloadable tips, version updates, online mode, platform save/feature differences, and non-English localizations are not treated as identical evidence states.
work_or_witnesses: ATLUS/SEGA, Unicorn Overlord official English (US) website: Story, World, Features, and Character selector
ATLUS/SEGA, Unicorn Overlord official English character data file
coverage_rule: All sixteen named individual cards in the English official character selector/data file: Alain, Scarlett, Lex, Josef, Ilenia, Chloe, Hodrick, Clive, Travis, Yahna, Melisandre, Gilbert, Virginia, Berengaria, Aramis, and Galerius. This is a reproducible selected-profile set, not the full roster: the official site advertises more than sixty unique characters. Classes, species, units, nations, factions, items, places, battle systems, and player-selectable content are dimensions/terms rather than character nodes.
omissions: Every unselected named recruit, NPC, enemy, ruler, or boss from the 60+-character wider roster; generic humans, elves, bestrals, angels, units, and classes.

Recruitment conditions and accept/decline branches, rapport/conversation/romance outcomes, deaths, endings, battle deployments, class changes, equipment, tactics, routes, difficulty, online matches, and every player-customized party outcome.

The demo, downloadable tips as a later instructional witness, patches/updates, DLC or edition bonuses, platform-specific behavior, physical/digital/collector editions, all non-English localizations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The official data file is a concise promotional profile set and its sixteen cards are not presented as a complete cast or full chronology; absent details remain absent.
Some profiles use past-tense event summaries. They establish only the stated preconditions/background, not a universal recruitment state, player deployment, survival, rapport, romance, or ending.

The site offers platform, demo, standard/collector, and online information but does not make their mechanics or content states interchangeable; no update-specific rule is assigned to a character card.
evidence_basis: ATLUS/SEGA first-party English official site and its published English character data file only. No fan or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.

citations.locator: Features, World, Purchase, and Character sections
supports: English-US scope, platforms, base-game framing, Fevrith/Cornia, selected character presentation, roster, item, and systems
